title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct expression for the deflection caused by Earth's rotation, L arcsin(Rω² sin 2θ / 2g).

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct expression for the lateral displacement, (1/3) * (8L³/g)^(1/3) * ω * cos θ.

title: Correct Use of Forces
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly identify and apply the fictitious centrifugal force and apparent gravity in their calculations.

title: Trigonometric Relationships
description: Important Criteria - The student must correctly derive the relationship between the forces using trigonometric functions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should check that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating the direction of deflection and displacement.

title: Numerical Estimates
description: Optional Criteria - The student should provide reasonable numerical estimates for L and θ based on the context of the problem.
